items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I think he worked a whole lot with Dave Peyton.

ctx.x: Well, I'm trying to think. I think he worked a whole lot with Dave Peyton. Yeah, he's up there along in that class, Dave Peyton. He worked a whole lot with Dave, I know. He worked a whole lot with Dave Peyton.
Yeah. Now, those trumpet players, let's start comparing some more of them to get that style down, if that helped you. Let's see. You see, nobody played much like Keppert, huh?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Sure, I knew Hilaire. He was a nice drummer.

ctx.x: But John Jelly Roll after Cliff. Cliff wasn't there when I joined him. But yeah, I saw him playing with Jelly Roll.

Did you know Hilaire Andrew? Sure, I knew Hilaire. He was a nice drummer. Where was he from? Here. And who did he play with in Lionhead? Did you know him back then? Well, Hilaire, I believe he played some too with this Jelly Roll.
And he played most with this man, played Clannett, what's his name, Dyer, when he was going to California? Jimmy Noon.
